tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: Search available motorcycle transport routes in France. Filter by departure city, arrival city, and date range. Returns paginated results with dates, prices, available slots, a next_cursor for the following page, and the booking URL. Primary route: Paris–Marseille from 299€. No authentication requir

tools.name: cities_near
tools.description: Find SYMONE-served cities near a given location. Pass a city or region name to get nearby cities where SYMONE operates motorcycle transport.

tools.name: get_booking_url
tools.description: Get the link the user must open to book a scheduled SYMONE trip or to request a quote for another route or date, plus reservation contacts. With route_id (from search_routes) the trip details are repeated next to the link. Booking and payment happen on symone.fr only.
